MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Management Services Agreement is entered into as of February 2, 2026 between Summit Health Partners LLC ("Manager") and Valley Internal Medicine, P.C. ("Practice").

1. Management. Manager will manage Practice and will have full authority over its operations.

2. Compensation. Manager will receive what remains after Practice's expenses are met.

3. Term. This Agreement has a term of twenty years.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.
